name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard matches 'If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again' (after a fall the hands are empty, so holding_box on the very next step is exactly picking it up on that move), and Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard matches 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box', where reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is added. Both events are declared, both clauses trace to their sentences, both are hard as worded, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid because both requirements are conditional, not unconditional goals.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be carrying the box at that moment.
